interpretation: 20.21: 'kathōs apestalken me ho patēr, kagō pempō hymas'; 20.22: 'labete pneuma hagion'; 20.23: 'an tinōn aphēte tas hamartias apheōntai autois; an tinōn kratēte kekratēntai'. Read as a report that Jesus, grounding the sending in his own sending by the Father, gives the disciples gathered the power to forgive and to retain sins; CommissionReport.powers jn20 = [forgiveAndRetain]. Context read: 20.19-29 (20.24: Thomas, one of the twelve, was not with them). Limits: textual report only; the recipients are 'the disciples' then present, not the twelve as such; the sending comparison is a report, not an established grant.
